name: Level up
description: Four rungs of the scale, climbed. One phrase of the composed interface note, so this figure and the victory one cannot drift apart, and its tempo is one number.
offBand: Under the set on purpose. Late in a run it plays several times a minute — every level, every purchase, every magnet — so at the level of a fanfare heard once a run it is the loudest thing the player hears most often; it only has to say something went up.
